description: Creates a backup, by volumeId or by instanceId (the instance's volume is resolved for you). The backup is held independently of the instance, so it survives the VM. Poll list_backups until the new backup is available.

instanceId.description: ID of the instance to back up - its bootable (else first) attached volume is resolved automatically, so no volume:list scope is needed. Provide this OR volumeId.

volumeId.description: ID of the volume to back up (see list_volumes). Provide this OR instanceId.

name: create_backup
title: Create backup
